Both responses are accurate and cover the same core points: chaining, open addressing, average O(1) lookups degrading to O(n), and resizing. Both also slightly exceed the 120-word limit. By my count, Response A is about 131 words and Response B about 124 (a little more if the list numbers are counted). Response A adds useful details, such as treeification in Java and clustering, but it overshoots the limit more. Response B stays closer to the limit and adds the amortized O(1) point about resizing. Since the length limit was explicit, B is slightly better.

**B**
